outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Same identity/materials/body scale, elevated three-quarter tactical view facing RIGHT. Twelve full-body articulated poses FOUR columns THREE rows with generous clear gutters, every shield/mace/foot complete inside own cell. Row1: idle balanced stance shield resting; alert breathing shoulders lift shield slightly; heavy walk near leg forward right; opposite walk near leg BACK left visibly overlapping far forward thigh, shield and mace stay in same hands. Row2: passing step knee lifts under hip; attack windup right elbow raised mace behind helmet, shield protecting chest; full mace downward-forward strike toward RIGHT with waist twist and bent front knee; defense deep planted crouch left elbow tucked shield raised covering chest/head. Row3: hit recoil shoulders tilt back shield jolted; dying knees buckle mace slipping low; falling on SIDE torso low shield leaning beside body; final dead empty inert armor lying on SIDE head and torso horizontal, eyes dark, shield and mace resting beside, no standing cutout rotation. Real joint articulation, no duplicate standing sprites, no effects or projectiles. Original gritty painterly raster. Plain pale gray background no shadows, checkerboard, text, borders or scenery. All original legal art.
